label: FDA recall notices and status reports
statusNote: Part 7 subpart C is guidance, not a requirement: it states FDA policy on recalls. A firm may start a recall on its own and need not wait for FDA (7.46). Recall status report timing is set by FDA for each recall, generally between 2 and 4 weeks (7.53). Checked on eCFR 2026-11-05.

triggers.label: Recall decision
triggers.hint: The time the firm decides to recall or FDA requests a recall.

clocks.label: Notify each direct account
clocks.rule: Notify each affected direct account promptly (21 CFR 7.49). For Class I and Class II recalls mark the communication urgent; identify the product and lot numbers, the reason, the hazard and the instructions. The 24 hour term is this exercise's planning target, not a number in the regulation.

clocks.label: First recall status report
clocks.rule: Status reports at intervals FDA sets for each recall, generally between 2 and 4 weeks (21 CFR 7.53). The 14 day term is the short end of that range, used as a planning default.

appliesTo.note: Firms recalling FDA-regulated food. USDA FSIS recalls of meat, poultry and egg products follow FSIS directives.
